clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother lying awake over money in March 1988, then stopping talk with your father about money by May 1988; your brother's grades falling in November 1989; your mother growing calmer once back at work by March 1990. The shifts pile up across nearly two years with the death sitting among them, and the pattern of distance between your parents with your brother's functioning down afterward suggests the family's balance was disturbed through this time.
